paragraphs: Hearing this excellent Pauranic theme in the company of his brothers, Raghava was greatly surprised. Thereupon hearing the words of the Rishi he said : — •“ By thy favour I have listened to the highly sacred theme. O foremost of Munis? 1 was greatly worked up with curiosity in this matter. I am not the least surprised to learn, O twice-born one, that those two sons of the celestials would be two highly powerful leading monkeys since their origin is divine.” Rama having said this Agastya said : — “O thou having long arms, thus in the days of yore the birth of Vali and Sugriva was brought about. O king, I shall now again relate to thee another divine theme.

O Rama 1 shall now describe to thee why' did Ravana steal Sita. Do thou hear it attentively. O Rama, in the golden age, having bowed unto the Patriarch’s soji, the truthful Rishi Sanatkuinar, highly efi'ulg(=‘nt, resplandent like unto the sun, shining in his native brilliance and seated at his own place, RSvana, the lord of Rak.shasas, said : — “Who is now amongst the celestials brave and powerful, by whose help the celestials can vanquish their enemies and whom the twiceborn ones daily worship and the devotees meditate upon. O thou having piety for wealth, O thou gifted vith six sorts of wealth, do thou describe this to me kindly.” Being apprised of Ravana's intention, the saint Sanatkuinar, who saw every thing through his devotion, said to him out of love — “ Hear my son. 'I'he learned duly, in their sacrifices, worship that Hari, respected of people and drinking nectar, who is the lord of the universe, whoso origin we do not know, who is daily worshipped by the celestials and Asuras, who is highly powerful Nartyana from whose navel lias spurng Brahma, the creator of the world, and Vvho has created the universe consisting of mobile and immobile beings.

The Yogis madilate upon him and celebrate sacrifices In his honor according to the Puranas, Vedas, Panchardtra and and other rituals. lie always vanquisheth in encounter Daityas Danavas, Rakshasas and all other enemies of the celestials and every one of them worships him.” Hearing those words of the great ascetic Sanatknmar, Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, bowing, replied : — “Being sh-iin by Hari to what station do the Daityas, ].)anavas and Rakshasas attain? And why doth Hari destroy them?” Whereto Sanatkuinar replied : — “ Whoever are slain by the celestials do eternally reside in their region. And being banished therefrom, they again take their birth on earth. Thus by the misery and happiness acquired in their pristine existence, they go through births and deaths.

O king, all the monarchs, slain by Janarddana, holding discus and the lord of the triple world, attained to his , own region ; even his anger becometh like a 2 1. 'I 169S RAMA YANA. boon.” Hearing those words given vent to by the great ascetic Sanatkumar the night-ranger Ravana, being worked up with delight and surprise, began to meditate how he should enter into conflict with Hari.

verses.sa:
अभिषिक्ते तु काकुत्स्थे धर्मेण विदितात्मनि ।
व्यतीता या निशा पूर्वा पौराणां हर्षवर्धिनी ॥

तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां प्रातर्नृपतिबोधकाः ।
वन्दिनः समुपातिष्ठन्सौम्या नृपतिवेश्मनि ॥

ते रक्तकण्ठिनः सर्वे किन्नरा इव शिक्षिताः ।
तुष्टुवुर्नपतिं वीरं यथावत् सम्प्रहर्षिणः ॥

वीर सौम्य प्रबुध्यस्व कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन ।
जगद्धि सर्वं स्वपिति त्वयि सुप्ते नराधिप ॥

विक्रमस्ते यथा विष्णो रूपं चैवाश्विनोरिव ।
बुद्ध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यः प्रजापतिसमो ह्यसि ॥

क्षमा ते पृथिवीतुल्या तेजसा भास्करोपमः ।
वेगस्ते वायुना तुल्यो गाम्भीर्यमुदधेरिव ॥

अप्रकम्प्यो यता स्थाणुश्चन्द्रे सौम्यत्वमीदृशम् ।
नेदृशाः पार्थिवाः पूर्वं भवितारो नराधिप ॥

यथा त्वमतिदुर्धर्षो धर्मनित्यः प्रजाहितः ।
न त्वां जहाति कीर्तिश्च लक्ष्मीश्च पुरुषर्षभ ॥

श्रीश्च धर्मश्च काकुत्स्थ त्वयि नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितौ ।
एताश्चान्याश्च मधुरा वन्दिभिः परिकीर्तिताः ॥

सूताश्च संस्तवैर्दिव्यैर्बोधयन्ति स्म राघवम् ।
स्तुतिभिः स्तूयमानाभिः प्रत्यबुध्यत राघवः ॥

स तद्विहाय शयनं पाण्डराच्छादनास्तृतम् ।
उत्तस्थौ नागशयनाद्धरिर्नारायणो यथा ॥

तमुत्थितं महात्मानं प्रह्वाः प्राञ्जलयो नराः ।
सलिलं भाजनैः शुभ्रैरुपतस्थुः सहस्रशः ॥

कृतोदकशुचिर्भूत्वा काले हुतहुताशनः ।
देवागारं जगामाशु पुण्यमिक्ष्वाकुसेवितम् ॥

तत्र देवान्पितऽन्विप्रानर्चयित्वा यथाविधि ।
बाह्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम जनैर्वृतः ॥

उपतस्थुर्महात्मानो मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः ।
वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः ॥

क्षत्रियाश्च महात्मानो नानाजनपदेश्वराः ।
रामस्योपाविशन्पार्श्वे शक्रस्येव यथा ऽमराः ॥

भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चात्र शत्रुघ्नश्च महायशाः ।
उपासाञ्चक्रिरे हृष्टा वेदास्त्रय इवाध्वरम् ॥

याताः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा किङ्करा मुदिताननाः ।
मुदिता नाम पार्श्वस्था बहवः समुपाविशन् ॥

वानराश्च महावीर्या विंशतिः कामरूपिणः ।
सुग्रीवप्रमुखा राममुपासन्ते महौजसः ॥

विभीषणश्च रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिः परिवारितः ।
उपासते महात्मानं धनेशमिव गुह्यकाः ॥

तथा निगमवृद्धाश्च कुलीना ये च मानवाः ।
शिरसा ऽ ऽवन्द्य राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः ॥

तथा परिवृतो राजा श्रीमद्भिर्ऋषिभिर्वृतः ।
राजभिश्च महावीर्यैर्वानरैश्च सराक्षसैः ॥

यथा देवेश्वरो नित्यमृषिभिः समुपास्यते ।
अधिकस्तेन रूपेण सहस्राक्षाद्विरोचते ॥

तेषां समुपविष्टानां तास्ताः सुमधुराः कथाः ।
कथ्यन्ते धर्मसंयुक्ताः पुराणज्ञैर्महात्मभिः ॥
